facts.fact: Ethiopian News Agency reports that the Ethiopian Communications Authority, whose Director General Balcha Reba spoke, acts under its legal mandate on personal data protection and held a stakeholder consultation on the Proclamation's implementation.
Ethiopian News Agency reports on 13 May 2026 that the Communications Authority held a consultation on the implementation and application of Personal Data Protection Proclamation 1321/2016 EC.

The Communications Authority's Director General said a portal has been prepared for individuals to report personal-data breaches to the regulator, and the Authority held a stakeholder consultation on implementation, with no decision stated.
